questions.question: Through the prophet Ezekiel, God said the soul who sins will die for whose sin?
God said through Ezekiel that a wicked man who turns from all his sins will still die for them. True or false?
Through the prophet Ezekiel, God said He takes no pleasure in the death of the wicked. What would He prefer for them?

answers.text: That they turn from their ways and live
That they pay for every one of their sins
That they stay far away from Israel

questions.question: When Israel said the Lord's way was not just, God replied that Israel's own ways were unjust. True or false?
